test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The novel was being read by many people.

options.text: The novel was read by many people.
Many people were reading the novel.
The novel is being read by many people.
Many people had read the novel.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Many people were reading the novel**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The active voice construction for this sentence places the subject "**many people**" first.
 
• In the passive voice sentence, "**The novel was being read by many people**," the object "**the novel**" in the passive sentence becomes the object in the active sentence.
 
• The verb "**was being read**" changes to "**were reading**" to suit the active form.
 
• The overall meaning of the sentence remains the same, emphasizing that multiple people were engaged in the action of reading.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is '**Many people were reading the novel**'.

​Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The novel was read by many people.**

 
 
• This option is incorrect because it is still in passive voice and in past simple tense, not the continuous tense indicated.
 
 
 
• **The novel is being read by many people.**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because it is in passive voice and in present continuous tense, rather than past continuous tense.
 
 
 
• **Many people had read the novel.**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because it uses past perfect tense and changes the meaning of the original sentence.
